title: Stop Letting AI Agents Just Chat
description: Are your AI agents actually working or just wasting compute? Discover why Paperclip treats agents like employees with structured tasks instead of aimless chatter. How are you managing your AI workforce? Let us know below!
transcript: In Paperclip, your agents become employees. You give them managers, you assign them tasks. They can talk to each other, but it's not what you think. It's through the task, intentional and focused. I haven't seen a lot of super value out of like agent conference room or an agent town where you just set your agents to sit there and talk to each other.
hook_reason: This clip clearly explains the unique value proposition of Paperclip as a 'meta harness' for managing AI agents as employees, which is a compelling hook for tech-focused viewers.
